experiment: multi-geometry - one model, two device classes
dataset: Kuber self-generated corpus (there is no public cold-plate CHT benchmark)
model: Kuber SurfaceGeoTransolver (full-geometry / surface input) with a device flag + physics conditioning
notes: One model trained on both heatsinks (wall-temperature BC, buoyancy-driven, air) and cold plates (heat-flux BC, forced liquid), distinguished by a device flag + fluid/BC conditioning. Cold plates are straight-channel; topology diversity is on the roadmap. Evaluated per device class on held-out cases from the same corpus. Not comparable to the SIMSHIFT numbers (different training set and test distribution).
